RULE NUMBER ONE

Concentrate.

Collect gold, eight hidden letters, and four amphorae. Blue crystals refill magic; green nectar restores health. Watch a boss's wind-up, dodge, then strike while it recovers. In rush chapters, keep jumping.

Progress and your controls are saved in this browser. Every chapter is available from the title screen.
